task.question: Return the 3 tickers with the deepest (most negative) maximum drawdown over their entire history, ordered from deepest to shallowest. Max drawdown is min(close/running_max(close) - 1).

result.question: Return the 3 tickers with the deepest (most negative) maximum drawdown over their entire history, ordered from deepest to shallowest. Max drawdown is min(close/running_max(close) - 1).
result.cited_sql:
WITH drawdowns AS (
  SELECT 
    i.ticker,
    p.close,
    MAX(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY i.ticker ORDER BY p.date) as running_max,
    (p.close / MAX(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY i.ticker ORDER BY p.date)) - 1 as drawdown
  FROM prices p
  JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id
),
max_drawdowns AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    MIN(drawdown) as max_drawdown
  FROM drawdowns
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT 
  ticker,
  max_drawdown
FROM max_drawdowns
ORDER BY max_drawdown ASC
LIMIT 3
